Oven-Baked Chicken Legs with Potatoes 🍗 Ingredients: * 6–7 chicken leg quarters * 2–3 lbs potatoes * 4–5 garlic cloves, minced * 3–4 tbsp olive oil * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste * 1 tsp paprika * 1 tsp chicken seasoning * ½ tsp ground coriander Instructions: 1. Cut each chicken leg into two pieces and make a few small slits in the meat. 2. In a large bowl, combine salt, black pepper, paprika, chicken seasoning, ground coriander, minced garlic, and olive oil. Mix well. 3. Add the chicken and coat each piece thoroughly with the seasoning mixture. Let marinate for 30–60 minutes. 4. Peel the potatoes and cut them into bite-sized pieces. Place them on a baking tray. Add salt, paprika, ground coriander, and olive oil. Toss until evenly coated. 5. Arrange the marinated chicken pieces on top of the potatoes. 6. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Bake for 50–60 minutes, until the chicken is fully cooked, golden brown, and the potatoes are tender. Farming isn’t always sunshine, fluffy lambs and driving tractors about! 😂🐑

Behind the scenes, there’s early mornings, late nights and a huge amount of hard work that often goes unnoticed.

That’s why I’m teaming up with @aldiuk for their Specially Selected Farming Heroes campaign! 🇬🇧

🏆 Aldi is giving THREE deserving farmers £5,000 EACH to recognise their hard work and dedication to British farming!

🐄 HOW TO NOMINATE:

1. Think of a farmer who deserves recognition.
2. Nominations should be sent to farmingheroes@aldi.co.uk
3. Tell Aldi why your Farming Hero deserves to win!

📅 Nominations close 23rd December 2026!

Whether they’ve spent their whole life farming, overcome huge challenges or simply go above and beyond every day, we want to hear about them!

❤️ TAG your Farming Hero, SHARE this with your farming friends and let’s give British farmers the recognition they deserve! 🚜🇬🇧

#AldiUK #FarmingHeroes #BritishFarming #SupportBritishFarmers
